interface.title: gathervis
interface.field: Exploration seismology / geophysics (seismic data processing and QC)
interface.stage_of_work: Pre-stack data QC and early processing: browsing shot gathers, checking acquisition geometry, trying filter, gain and mute settings, and picking first breaks and events
interface.what_it_is_for: A browser viewer that lets a geophysicist step through pre-stack shot gathers, change filter, gain, mute and display settings and see the result live, pick events and first breaks, check acquisition geometry and CMP fold, and view the shot × receiver × time volume as 3-D slices.

data.note: Default 'geo' demo: a synthetic 2-D line of 48 shots × 120 receivers × 1001 samples (2 ms, to 2.000 s, 23.1 MB float32), 48 sources sharing one spread. It shows a direct arrival, two hyperbolic reflections and random noise. There are no test files, so none of the Import buttons was tried.

tree.general: Check the quality of a recorded survey line and prepare its records for processing
tree.specific: QC a synthetic 2-D pre-stack line in gathervis: browse shot gathers, check geometry and fold, filter and gain, pick, mute, view the volume and save images. Spectral analysis and CMP velocity analysis, two headline workflows, are not covered (see not_done).

features.name: Record stepper with live processing chain
features.general: Step through a series of 2-D records while a chain of filter and gain settings is re-applied live to whichever record is shown
features.specific: Shot slider, field and arrow keys, with the Band-pass f1–f4 corners and AGC or trace balance re-applied to each shot gather
steps: choose a filter type and type its corner frequencies
choose a gain type (AGC window or trace balance)
step records with the slider, the field or ←/→ (Shift for ten)
serves_tasks: Step through records to check each one
Even out amplitudes across the record

features.name: Seismic image display controls and image export
features.general: Show a 2-D array either as a colour image or as wiggle lines, with a colormap and a percentile clip, read the value under the pointer, and save the displayed record as an image
features.specific: Density/Wiggle mode, Colormap (gray, seismic, petrel…), Clip percentile and Traces count for wiggles; hovering reads trace, time and amp; Full image downloads the gather as a PNG named by shot (and sort). Flip polarity is present but was not tried.
steps: switch Density or Wiggle
pick a colormap
drag the clip percentile
hover to read trace, time and amplitude
press Full image to download the displayed gather as PNG
serves_tasks: Change how the record is drawn
Read values at a point on the record
Save a picture of the current record

features.name: Point picking with snap and export
features.general: Tap points on an image to mark a feature, snap each one to a nearby extremum, keep the picks per record and export them as CSV
features.specific: Event picking tool: tap adds a pick, drag moves it, Backspace deletes it; Snap Off/Peak/Trough/|max|; Clear shot/Clear all; Export to picks.csv (shot, trace, time_s)
steps: turn on the pick tool in the plot toolbar
choose a snap mode
tap along the event
export the picks

features.name: STA/LTA automatic onset picker
features.general: Detect the first arrival on each signal with a short-term/long-term average ratio and tune its window lengths and trigger level, re-running until the picks follow the onset
features.specific: First breaks panel: STA (s), LTA (s) and Trigger ratio, then Auto pick (STA/LTA) on the displayed (filtered) gather; Clear picks
steps: set the STA and LTA window lengths
set the trigger ratio
press Auto pick
raise the ratio and pick again if picks trigger on noise
serves_tasks: Detect first arrivals automatically and tune the detector

features.name: Editable mute lines with default and per-record overrides
features.general: Draw top and bottom cut-off lines that blank part of every record, seed one from a simple linear model, give single records their own exceptions and export everything as JSON
features.specific: Mute panel: Seed top mute from velocity and delay; top and bottom line tools (tap, drag or Backspace nodes); Apply mute with taper; Scope All gathers or This gather; Make default/Revert (not tried); Export mutes.json stored against offset
steps: seed the top mute from velocity and delay
tick Apply mute
switch the scope to This gather and tap nodes for an exception line
export the mutes
serves_tasks: Blank out an unwanted zone of the record

features.name: Coverage map with re-binning and map-to-record link
features.general: Map the survey layout with a coverage heat map, change the binning cell size to recompute coverage statistics, and tap a source on the map to open its record in the viewer
features.specific: Geometry tab: Fold, Receivers and Sources layers; CMP bin x and y with Grid, Live bins and Fold readouts; a hover readout of bin and fold; tapping a source opens that shot on Shot gathers
steps: toggle the map layers
zoom and hover or tap bins to read fold
change the bin size and read the fold statistics
tap a source to jump to its shot gather
serves_tasks: Look at the coverage map for gaps
Re-bin the coverage at another cell size
Jump from a place on the map to its record

features.name: Orthogonal 3-D slice viewer
features.general: Show three orthogonal slices of a 3-D array in a rotatable cube; move each slice with sliders or keys and stretch each axis
features.specific: Volume slices tab: shot, rec and time sliders; keys 1/2/3 choose a slice, ←/→ (Shift for big steps) and Home/End move it; per-axis stretch sliders; Reset camera
steps: choose a slice with 1, 2 or 3
move it with its slider or the arrow keys
stretch an axis
drag to rotate, then Reset camera
serves_tasks: Slice through a 3-D block along each axis

features.name: Trace re-sorting within a record
features.general: Reorder the traces of a record by a header attribute such as source–receiver distance, with the axis labelled by the sort key and its range, and return to acquisition order
features.specific: Sort dropdown on Shot gathers ('as recorded', 'offset'); the trace axis reads e.g. 'trace (sorted by offset, 7-2532 m)'. Exported picks kept recorded trace numbers on an offset-sorted display, and mutes are stored against offset.
steps: choose 'offset' in Sort
read the sorted axis label and its offset range
choose 'as recorded' to restore acquisition order
serves_tasks: Reorder the traces in a record by another attribute

screens_never_reached: Amplitude spectrum and f-k spectrum panels: both need an analysis window. The box and polygon tools never created one (windows.json export stayed empty), so neither 'Compute spectrum' nor 'f-k of first window' produced a panel.

CMP gather / velocity analysis (semblance) view: not in the running 'geo' demo, which has only the Shot gathers, Geometry and Volume slices tabs. Tapping a fold bin selects it but opens no CMP gather, and ?tab=3 opens Shot gathers (screens/042.webp). The view is reachable through the separate examples/velocity_picking.py entry point, which this run did not start.
not_done: MISSING PHASE — spectral analysis: draw an analysis window (box or polygon) on a gather and compute its amplitude spectrum and f-k spectrum. This is a headline workflow of the tool, left out of the tree because the box tool needs a Shift-held drag or a press-and-hold, which this browser cannot do; click-move-click, double-click starts and polygon vertex clicks all left no window behind.
Spectrum options (Per trace/Mean/Middle trace, Linear/dB, panel size S/M/L) could not be seen working without a window.

MISSING PHASE — velocity analysis on a CMP gather (pick on the semblance, check the moveout-corrected panel flattens the event, export velocities): reachable by starting examples/velocity_picking.py, but skipped in this run; the 'geo' demo has no CMP or velocity view.
Reloading or sharing a settings URL: the URL parameters (shot, sort, cmap, clip, filter, f3, f4, gain, tab) were seen to update, but no one reloaded a URL to check the settings come back.
Make default / Revert for a single-gather mute was not tried.
Import buttons for windows, picks and mutes: there are no test files to upload, so no export/import round trip was done.
Other demo modes (browse, slices, single, patch) were not tried: they need the server restarted with another argument.

Height slider, the three icon buttons beside it, Resolution and Flip polarity were not tried; Low-pass and High-pass filters were not tried separately. Dragging or Backspace-deleting a pick, and Home/End in the slice viewer, were not tried.
